if: the document is a credit note or a debit note referred to in section 34
it is issued under rule 53(1A) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the credit or debit note MUST carry the signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1A)(i), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative.
